description: Estimate new registration plus subsequent renewals for one TLD at a registrar. Returns null for unknown multi-year term totals. Not a transfer or existing-domain renewal quote.

name.description: One ASCII domain label without the extension, such as myproject. Price and link tools only build links from it; availability and popularity tools send the exact domain to their providers.

registrar.description: Connected registrar ID from the registrars endpoint. Omit to compare all.

tld.description: One covered ASCII top-level extension, such as com or .com. Multi-part suffixes and IDNs are not covered.

years.description: Planning horizon in years, including initial registration.

name: estimate_cost

Comparison.description: Revisit current standard prices with supported website filters. Omits proposed names and API pagination; does not save prices or availability.

omittedParameters.description: Estimate horizons outside 2, 3, 5 and 10 years use the website default. Favorites are browser-local preferences and are never written by a link. Disclose omitted settings.

CostBreakdown.description: Conservative new-registration estimate, matching the UI. Null for unknown minimum-term totals.

estimateYears.description: Planning horizon in years, including initial registration.

estimatedTotalCents.description: Null for multi-year minimum terms; not zero.

nextRefreshAt.description: When the saved catalog is due for its next scheduled refresh; not an expiry of its prices.

priceValidUntil.description: When a scheduled price change takes effect or the exchange rate behind a converted price expires; recheck after this time.

pricingBasis.description: Absent for published price lists. sampled_standard: standard-tier prices sampled from registrar search results (Cloudflare). sampled_api (API 1.9.0): registrar API purchase and auto-renewal rates sampled with a synthetic name (GoDaddy); the registrar website and manual renewals can charge more. Both have limited coverage and are not exact-name quotes. Preserve this distinction when displaying or reusing prices.

renewalSince.description: API 1.12.0: when this renewal price (with its regular price) was first seen; unchanged since. Absent when not yet dated. See renewalSinceFirstRecord and the price history endpoint.

renewalSinceFirstRecord.description: True when renewalSince is our earliest record of this price, so the price may be older. Say "unchanged since at least" that date.

stale.description: True when the source’s last refresh failed and its saved catalog is at least 24 hours old. Passing nextRefreshAt alone does not make prices stale; a scheduled refresh every 15 minutes replaces due catalogs.

ServiceInformation.description: Cheapest Domains identity and optional setup links, separate from upstream evidence. Does not establish client installation or provider health.

nextRefreshAt.description: When the saved catalog is due for its next scheduled refresh; not an expiry of its prices.

refresh.description: Progress of a staged catalog refresh, when one exists. Saved prices remain usable meanwhile.

stale.description: True when the source’s last refresh failed and its saved catalog is at least 24 hours old. Passing nextRefreshAt alone does not make prices stale; a scheduled refresh every 15 minutes replaces due catalogs.

outputSchema.description: Successful results are Estimate, the REST 200 response; results with isError: true are Error.
